metadata.title: A new concept of frequency-excitation-up conversion to improve the yield of linear piezoelectric generators

configuration.quote: a single piezoelectric cantilever beam is added to the friction system
configuration.section: a b s t r a c t

proof_mass.quote: the tip mass of the piezoelectric cantilever beam is removed

length_mm.quote: cantilever beam (50 mm x 16 mm x 0.3 mm)

width_mm.quote: cantilever beam (50 mm x 16 mm x 0.3 mm)

thickness_mm.quote: cantilever beam (50 mm x 16 mm x 0.3 mm)

piezo_thickness_um.quote: piezoelectric layer 17 mm x 16 mm x 0.25 mm

type.quote: vibrator starts to reciprocate in sine motion

acceleration_g.quote: corresponding equivalent excitation accelerations are 0.79, 1.78, 3.16, and 4.93 m/s^2

load_resistance_ohm.quote: optimal resistance here is sharply reduced to 15 kOhm
